svg.aria-label: How Lending works. Lend turns your USDC into USDCn in the Null Collateral Vault, and you lend it into a long market, such as AAPLr | USDCn, where Leverage Long traders borrow it. Or you lend AAPLr you hold into its short market, USDCn | AAPLr, where Leverage Short traders borrow it, and you keep its price exposure.
